prompt: Search scoping misbehaves in a few ways. When a specific owner/name repo filter is combined with the search-everything option, the search ignores the specific repo and searches all repos anyway. An empty query with the search-everything option in JSON mode opens the interactive UI instead of emitting JSON. A reused decoded result can also end up carrying more than one populated payload. Make the more specific filter win and keep these paths consistent. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: search repo scoping all-repos filter precedence
search HasFilters JSON output empty query TUI
search config filters interactive versus json mode
_subject: search: address PR review — repo scoping, HasFilters, JSON invariant
